displayName: PMIC Company Fundamentals and Filing Risk
description: Scored company briefs from SEC EDGAR for 14 large US companies (Apple, Microsoft, Nvidia, Amazon, Walmart, JPMorgan, Bank of America, Exxon, Pfizer, Lilly, J&J, UnitedHealth, Netflix, Disney): a fundamentals score built from XBRL revenue, income, cash flow, cash, debt, margins and liquidity, a filing risk score from 8-K items, 13D filings and insider Form 4 activity, an insider activity score, a balance sheet strength score, and a peer ranking against the other 13 companies on growth, margins and liquidity. Every input carries its SEC citation. POST /v1/brief with a small JSON body for one scored, cited brief; POST /v1/overview for all of them at once. Results vary as public data updates (5-minute cache). Research signal, not investment advice. Pay per request in USDC; no account, no API key.

inputSchema.description: Body for POST /v1/brief (other routes take similar small bodies).

entity_id.description: Company (lower-case ticker); required for fundamentals, filing-risk, insider-activity, balance-sheet, peer-ranking, public-attention.

outputSchema.description: {service, vertical, title, status, score (0-100), label, trend, trend_basis, summary, drivers[], risk_flags[], confidence{score,label}, coverage, inputs[], watch[], citations[{url}], method}. Errors return a JSON object with an error field (HTTP 400).
